data.title: Finding the Area of Triangles and Parallelograms
data.description: Practice calculating the area of various triangles and parallelograms using their base and height measurements.

challenges.narration: A sail on a sailboat is shaped like this triangle.
challenges.instruction: Find the area of this triangle.
challenges.hint: A triangle is half of a rectangle. Area = ½ × base × height. Use the perpendicular (dashed) height, not a slanted side.

challenges.narration: A leaning bookshelf panel is shaped like this parallelogram.
challenges.instruction: Find the area of this parallelogram.
challenges.hint: Area of a parallelogram = base × height. Use the perpendicular (dashed) height.

challenges.narration: The side panel of a ramp is shaped like this parallelogram.
challenges.instruction: Find the area of this parallelogram.
challenges.hint: Area of a parallelogram = base × height. Use the perpendicular (dashed) height.

challenges.narration: A slice of pizza is shaped like this triangle.
challenges.instruction: Find the area of this triangle.
challenges.hint: A triangle is half of a rectangle. Area = ½ × base × height. Use the perpendicular (dashed) height, not a slanted side.
